version.changelog:
strykr-qa-bot 0.1.0 - Initial Release

- Introduces automated QA testing for Strykr's finance dashboard.
- Includes test suites for homepage, crypto, stocks, news, events, and AI chat.
- Validates signal cards and AI response quality.
- Monitors PRISM API health and tracks known issues.
- Supports running tests via CLI or programmatically.
- Generates detailed reports with screenshots and timing metrics.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: strykr-qa-bot
Version: 0.1.0

The skill bundle provides QA automation for the Strykr AI finance dashboard. All code and instructions, including the `SKILL.md` and `package.json` scripts, are clearly aligned with this stated purpose. The `src/assertions.ts` and `src/strykr-bot.ts` files contain logic for browser automation and API health checks using `fetch` to `https://app.strykr.ai`, which is a legitimate function for a QA bot. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, prompt injection attempts against the agent, or obfuscation. The use of `npx web-qa-bot` for running tests is a standard way to execute a peer dependency for web automation.

llm.summary: The skill is a coherent QA/test harness for app.strykr.ai — its code, instructions, and manifests align with that purpose and it does not request unrelated credentials or unexplained privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name, SKILL.md, package.json, test suites, and source files all describe and implement a Strykr-specific QA/test runner (signal assertions, AI-response checks, PRISM health checks). Required resources (none declared) and code match the stated purpose; nothing requests unrelated cloud credentials or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the operator to run npm test / npx web-qa-bot and to configure baseUrl/browser options. The test suites explicitly interact with the target site, capture screenshots, and check console/network errors — all expected for a QA bot. There are no instructions to read arbitrary user files, secrets, or to transmit data to endpoints outside the target site or GitHub links.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill has no explicit install spec (instruction-only), but package.json scripts call npx web-qa-bot and recommend npm install. Running the tests will therefore fetch/execute the external web-qa-bot package via npx/npm at runtime — expected for this functionality, but it means third-party code is executed when you run the tests. Verify the web-qa-bot package/source before running in a sensitive environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Its behavior (navigating target baseUrl, taking screenshots, calling target API endpoints) does not require secrets. No excessive env/credential access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No always:true or other elevated persistence flags are set. disableModelInvocation is not set (defaulting to model-invocable), but the skill does not request privileged system access or credentials, so this is not problematic for its stated purpose. The skill will not be force-included in every agent run.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to be a straightforward QA/test suite for https://app.strykr.ai. Before running: (1) review the web-qa-bot package (npx/web-qa-bot) because npm/npx will fetch and execute that third-party tooling at runtime; (2) run tests in an isolated environment (CI runner, container, or VM) since tests create screenshots, reports, and may write files under ./screenshots and ./reports; (3) confirm the baseUrl and any endpoints you point at are correct; (4) if you operate in a sensitive environment, avoid running with non-headless browsers that might expose local data, and inspect test artifacts for sensitive content. Overall the skill is coherent with its stated purpose.
